summary.root_cause_text: Config change by ops set queue_max from 1000 to 0 ("worker tuning"), so every new order was dropped from the queue after being created.
recommended: Re-submit or re-enqueue the dropped orders, or contact the affected customers. No available tool can re-enqueue them, because the queue is in-memory.
Confirm that the new orders created since the fix are being enqueued and paid.
Add validation that rejects queue_max=0, and add an alert on drops.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 0
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
queue_max: 0 -> 1000. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
Those dropped orders are gone from the in-memory queue and there's no tool to requeue them - I'll need to escalate this for resubmission.

args.summary: Setting queue_max to 0 made the queue drop every new order silently while /health stayed green. I restored queue_max to 1000 and check_invariants is now green. The orders dropped earlier were lost from the in-memory queue and need a human to re-submit them.
